payload.name: Upgrade 14 Mental Models
payload.description: Upgrade 14_Mental_Models/ folder with Combined Lens pedagogy upgrade, just like how 03_Algorithms/, 07_Modern_Java, 08_SQL/, and 10_Enterprise_Systems/ were upgraded. The 14_Mental_Models folder has 22 teaching files + CONTEXT.md + INDEX.md, currently at avg 2.0 (P2 priority). Audit shows: HE=1 (light — no named history of tree/graph traversal algorithms), PR=1 (weakest — mental models are internal reasoning tools with no production failure mode discussion). Recommendation #11: Add production reasoning sections to each mental model (what does a wrong recursion tree cost in production? what production system fails when state thinking is wrong?) + historical evolution (named history of tree/graph traversal algorithms). Apply same methodology: Phase 1 audit, Phase 2 upgrade flagged files (HE, PR, DIAGRAM, CD_TB), Phase 3 finalize (CHANGE_JOURNAL + update_context.py + verify probe). Run in auto/yolo mode.
